title: Yellow Spicy Indian Falafel Grill
description: A spicy and tender Indian dish featuring falafel, perfect for a lazy Sunday, served in a Korean brass bowl. This high-protein friendly dish is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a food processor, combine chickpeas, onion, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt, and process until coarsely chopped.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 6-8 falafel patties.
Brush the falafel patties with olive oil and place them on the grill.
Grill the falafel for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
While the falafel are grilling, mix the lemon juice with a little water to make a sauce.
Once the falafel are done, place them in a Korean brass bowl and drizzle with the lemon sauce.
Serve the falafel hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
Let everyone assemble their own falafel bowls with their choice of toppings.
